table.name: cards
table.purpose: Printing-level catalog of Magic: The Gathering cards (one row per physical/digital printing of a card in a set), in the style of MTGJSON's AllPrintings 'cards' data.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Surrogate integer primary key for the card printing row.

col_003.name: reverse_related
col_003.description: Name of a related card; populated only for a handful of very old (Arabian Nights-era) cards. Possibly the 'reverseRelated' field, but the evidence is thin.

col_004.name: availability
col_004.description: Comma-separated list of platforms the printing is available on: paper, mtgo, arena, shandalar.

col_005.name: border_color
col_005.description: Card border color: black, white, silver (Un-sets), gold (champion cards), borderless.

col_008.name: colors
col_008.description: Mana colors of the card (W, U, B, R, G), comma-separated; null for colorless cards.

col_009.name: color_indicator
col_009.description: Color indicator pips printed on the card (e.g. on back faces / older cards); almost always null.

col_010.name: color_identity
col_010.description: Commander color identity (colors of mana symbols in rules text and cost).

col_011.name: converted_mana_cost
col_011.description: Converted mana cost (0-14 typically; 1000000 appears to encode a special/infinite cost).

col_012.name: duel_deck
col_012.description: Duel-deck side indicator ('a' or 'b') for cards from Duel Decks products.

col_013.name: edhrec_rank
col_013.description: EDHREC popularity rank (1 = most popular commander card); null for cards not ranked. Range and null pattern fit, but not certain.

col_014.name: face_converted_mana_cost
col_014.description: Converted mana cost of a single face of a multi-face card (split/transform); null for normal cards.

col_015.name: face_name
col_015.description: Name of an individual face of a multi-face card (e.g. 'Fire' of Fire // Ice).

col_016.name: flavor_name
col_016.description: Alternate flavor name (e.g. the Godzilla-series alternate names on Ikoria cards).

col_017.name: flavor_text
col_017.description: Flavor text printed on the card.

col_018.name: frame_effects
col_018.description: Comma-separated frame effect flags: legendary, extendedart, showcase, nyxtouched, miracle, snow, etc.

col_021.name: is_oversized
col_021.description: Flag for oversized (promo jumbo) cards; only ~12 such printings exist.

col_022.name: is_textless
col_022.description: Flag for textless printings; ~29 such cards.

col_023.name: is_reprint
col_023.description: Flag indicating the card has been printed in an earlier set (~61% true, consistent with reprint volume).

col_024.name: is_paper
col_024.description: Flag indicating the printing exists physically (~90% true, matching paper availability).

col_025.name: is_full_art
col_025.description: Flag for full-art printings (mostly basic lands and promos).

col_028.name: is_timeshifted
col_028.description: Flag for timeshifted/futureshifted printings (Time Spiral block).

col_029.name: is_online_only
col_029.description: Flag for printings that exist only digitally (MTGO/Arena-only), ~10% of rows.

col_031.name: is_alternative
col_031.description: Flag for alternative-version printings (alternate art/frames within a set).

col_032.name: has_foil
col_032.description: Flag indicating the printing is available in foil.

col_033.name: has_content_warning
col_033.description: Flag for cards with content warnings (ante/demonic-theme cards); very rare.

col_036.name: keywords
col_036.description: Comma-separated keyword abilities (Flying, Trample, Cycling, Equip, etc.).

col_037.name: layout
col_037.description: Card layout: normal, transform, modal_dfc, split, adventure, leveler, augment, scheme, etc.

col_038.name: leadership_skills
col_038.description: Dict of format legality as a commander: brawl / commander / oathbreaker booleans.

col_039.name: life
col_039.description: Vanguard card life modifier (-8 to +30); null for non-Vanguard cards.

col_040.name: hand
col_040.description: Vanguard card hand modifier; includes dice expressions like '1d4+1'.

col_041.name: mana_cost
col_041.description: Mana cost in MTG symbol notation, e.g. {1}{W}, {R/G}{R/G}.

col_042.name: multiverseid
col_042.description: Gatherer multiverse ID (up to ~535k, matching Gatherer's range); null for cards without a Gatherer entry. Could alternatively be a TCGplayer product ID.

col_043.name: mcm_id
col_043.description: Cardmarket (MCM) card ID; range up to ~330k fits Cardmarket IDs.

col_044.name: mcm_meta_id
col_044.description: Cardmarket meta/product ID (range ~7k-77k), null for most rows.

col_045.name: uuid_alt
col_045.description: Unique version-5 UUID per printing; a second unique identifier alongside col_072 (possibly a differently-namespaced card UUID).

col_046.name: mtgo_foil_id
col_046.description: MTGO identifier for the foil version (values ~303-70586); which of col_046/col_047 is the regular vs foil MTGO ID is uncertain.

col_047.name: mtgo_id
col_047.description: MTGO identifier (values ~9-87921); the sibling of col_046, one being the regular and one the foil MTGO ID.

col_048.name: tcgplayer_product_id
col_048.description: External product identifier up to ~508k, likely a TCGplayer product ID (or a second Gatherer-style ID).

col_050.name: number
col_050.description: Collector number within the set, including non-numeric forms like 'br79', 'jf324'.

col_051.name: original_release_date
col_051.description: Original release date for cards released outside normal set schedule (promos, Mystery Booster); null for regular printings.

col_052.name: original_text
col_052.description: Rules text as originally printed (old wordings/old templating); null for cards using current wording.

col_053.name: original_type
col_053.description: Type line as originally printed (e.g. 'Summon - Fungus' on old cards).

col_055.name: power
col_055.description: Creature power; includes special values like '*', '2+*', '∞'.

col_056.name: printings
col_056.description: Comma-separated list of set codes in which the card has been printed.

col_057.name: promo_types
col_057.description: Comma-separated promo categories: setpromo, prerelease, datestamped, boxtopper, boostrfun, mediainsert, etc.

col_058.name: purchase_urls
col_058.description: Dict of vendor purchase links (CardKingdom, Cardmarket, TCGplayer) via mtgjson.com redirect links.

col_059.name: rarity
col_059.description: Printing rarity: common, uncommon, rare, mythic.

col_060.name: scryfall_id
col_060.description: Version-4 UUID, nearly unique per printing — likely the Scryfall card ID.

col_061.name: scryfall_oracle_id
col_061.description: Version-4 UUID shared by all printings of the same card (~27k distinct) — likely Scryfall's oracle ID.

col_062.name: scryfall_illustration_id
col_062.description: Version-4 UUID shared by printings with the same artwork (basic lands share it across many sets) — likely Scryfall's illustration ID.

col_063.name: set_code
col_063.description: Code of the set this printing belongs to (e.g. 2XM, 4BB, DDL); references the sets table.

col_064.name: side
col_064.description: Face letter (a-e) for multi-face cards; null for single-face cards.

col_066.name: supertypes
col_066.description: Supertypes: Basic, Legendary, Snow, World, Ongoing.

col_068.name: text
col_068.description: Current rules text of the card (Oracle wording).

col_069.name: toughness
col_069.description: Creature toughness; includes special values like '*', '*+1'.

col_070.name: type
col_070.description: Full current type line, e.g. 'Creature — Kor Artificer', 'Basic Land — Plains'.

col_071.name: types
col_071.description: Comma-separated card types (Creature, Instant, Sorcery, Land, Artifact, Enchantment, Summon on old cards).

col_072.name: uuid
col_072.description: Canonical unique card-printing UUID (version 5); referenced by rulings, legalities and foreign_data tables.

col_073.name: other_face_ids
col_073.description: Comma-separated UUIDs of the other faces of a multi-face card; null for single-face cards.

col_074.name: watermark
col_074.description: Set/faction watermark on the card (mirran, phyrexian, guild names, 'set (XXX)').

table.name: foreign_data
table.purpose: Localized (non-English) text for Magic: The Gathering card printings: one row per card printing per foreign language, holding the translated name, rules text, type line, and flavor text, linked to the card record via a UUID.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Primary key; sequential integer identifier for each foreign-language card entry.

col_002.name: flavor_text
col_002.description: Flavor text of the card in the row's language; empty string when the card has no flavor text.

col_003.name: language
col_003.description: Name of the language of this translation (e.g. Japanese, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Ancient Greek, Sanskrit, Latin, Hebrew).

col_004.name: multiverse_id
col_004.description: Numeric identifier of this foreign printing in the Gatherer database; null for printings not indexed there. The exact system is not verifiable from this table alone, but the value pattern matches Gatherer multiverse IDs.

col_005.name: name
col_005.description: Card name translated into the row's language (e.g. 'Pacifismo' = Pacifism, 'Zyklop vom Blutfelsen' = Bloodfell Caves Cyclops).

col_006.name: rules_text
col_006.description: Rules/rules-box text of the card in the row's language; empty string for cards with no rules text.

col_007.name: type_line
col_007.description: Card type line in the row's language (e.g. 'Kreatur — Zyklop' = Creature — Cyclop); empty when unavailable.

col_008.name: card_uuid
col_008.description: UUID of the card printing this translation belongs to; references cards.col_072.

table.name: legalities
table.purpose: Per-card format legality records (Magic: The Gathering): for each card (identified by UUID) and each sanctioned format, whether the card is legal, banned, or restricted in that format. One row per card-format pair.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Surrogate primary key, sequential integer 1..427907 with no gaps; purely an internal row identifier.

col_002.name: format
col_002.description: Magic: The Gathering sanctioned format in which the card's legality is stated. Values observed are MTG format names: commander, legacy, vintage, duel (Duel Commander), modern, pauper, pioneer, premodern, penny (Penny Dreadful), etc. (15 distinct formats).

col_003.name: legality
col_003.description: Legality status of the card in the given format: 'Legal', 'Banned', or 'Restricted' (restricted = at most one copy allowed, Vintage-specific).

col_004.name: card_uuid
col_004.description: UUID of the card (Scryfall-style card UUID) whose legality this row records; references cards.col_072. Each card has one row per format (top values appear 15 times, matching the 15 formats).

table.name: rulings
table.purpose: MTG card rulings: official rules clarifications/Oracle rulings for individual cards, with the date the ruling was issued and a reference to the card it applies to.

col_001.name: ruling_id
col_001.description: Primary key; sequential integer ID of the ruling row.

col_002.name: ruling_date
col_002.description: Date the ruling was published/issued (range 2004-10-04 to 2021-02-05).

col_003.name: ruling_text
col_003.description: Text of the official ruling explaining how the card's rules work.

col_004.name: card_uuid
col_004.description: UUID of the card the ruling applies to; references cards.col_072 (card UUID).

table.name: set_translations
table.purpose: Localized names of Magic: The Gathering sets: one row per (set, language) pair, giving the set's name translated into that language. 1210 rows = 121 sets x 10 languages.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Synthetic primary key; sequential integer 1-1210, one per row.

col_002.name: language
col_002.description: Language of the translation (e.g. Chinese Simplified, French, German, Japanese, Russian). 10 distinct languages, each appearing 121 times.

col_003.name: set_code
col_003.description: MTG set code (e.g. 10E, M14, RTR, DDR) referencing sets.col_005; each of the 121 sets appears once per language.

col_004.name: translated_name
col_004.description: The set's name translated into the given language (e.g. 'イーブンタイド' = Eventide in Japanese, 'Ritorno a Ravnica' = Return to Ravnica in Italian). Null where no translation exists (~19%).

table.name: sets
table.purpose: Magic: The Gathering card sets/expansions (one row per set, promo line, or special product release), with release metadata, set codes, and links to external store IDs. Structure matches MTGJSON's Set data.

col_001.name: set_id
col_001.description: Primary key; internal numeric identifier for the set row.

col_002.name: base_set_size
col_002.description: Number of cards in the set's base printing (non-promo, non-extra) — the 'baseSetSize'. Distribution (max 1694, most sets small) and near-duplication with col_020 fit card counts; the joins to cards/foreign_data are likely spurious statistics artifacts, not real foreign keys.

col_003.name: block
col_003.description: Name of the block the set belongs to (e.g. 'Theros', 'Shadows over Innistrad'); null for sets outside a block. Repeated values like 'Core Set', 'Commander' suggest some entries are block-style groupings rather than strict blocks.

col_004.name: booster
col_004.description: JSON/Python-dict description of booster pack contents: per-sheet slot counts (basic, common, uncommon, rare/rareMythic, land, dfc/sfc slots) keyed by product variant ('default', 'arena'). Null for sets not sold in boosters.

col_005.name: code
col_005.description: Unique 3–5 character set code (e.g. 'TSP' Time Spiral, '10E' Tenth Edition, 'PGRN' Guilds of Ravnica promos). Referenced by cards and set_translations.

col_006.name: is_foil_only
col_006.description: Boolean flag; true for sets printed only in foil (167 sets, consistent with promo/premium sets).

col_007.name: is_online_only
col_007.description: Boolean flag; true for the 16 sets available only digitally (MTGO/Arena).

col_008.name: is_paper_only
col_008.description: Boolean flag; plausibly 'paper only' (106 sets never on MTGO), though the count seems low — could also be another set flag.

col_009.name: is_partial_preview
col_009.description: Boolean flag; true for the 26 sets that were partial previews of a later set.

col_010.name: is_foreign_only
col_010.description: Boolean flag; true for exactly one set, consistent with a foreign-language-only release.

col_011.name: block_code
col_011.description: Code of the block the set belongs to ('DEFAULT' for standalone sets, 'DCI'/'PMEI' for promo programs).

col_012.name: mcm_id
col_012.description: External ID for the set at Cardmarket (MKM); null for ~64% of sets (promos/memorabilia not listed there). The one-to-one joins to cards/foreign_data are likely statistical artifacts.

col_013.name: cardsphere_set_id
col_013.description: External Cardsphere set ID; present only for 10 recent sets (IDs 2371–3680), consistent with a newer database covering only recent sets. Could alternatively be another modern store ID.

col_014.name: mcm_name
col_014.description: Set name as listed at Cardmarket; pairs with col_012 (same null rate and row coverage).

col_015.name: parent_set_code
col_015.description: Code of the parent set for derivative releases (promos, masterpieces, variants); null for ~71% of sets. Sample values ('V10', 'PR', 'DRB') fit promo-to-parent links.

col_016.name: name
col_016.description: Full human-readable set name (e.g. 'Ultimate Masters', 'Magic Player Rewards 2001'); unique per row.

col_017.name: mtgo_code
col_017.description: Alternate set code used on MTGO/another platform; null for ~72% of sets. Repeated codes (ZNR x6) fit variant sets sharing a parent's code, so it could also be a 'code_v3'/alternate-code field rather than strictly MTGO.

col_018.name: release_date
col_018.description: Release date of the set (range 1993-08-05 Alpha to 2021-03-19); many promos use a generic January 1 date.

col_019.name: tcgplayer_group_id
col_019.description: External TCGplayer group/set ID; null for ~53% of sets (those not sold on TCGplayer). Value 62 repeated 21 times fits a shared 'promos' group.

col_020.name: total_set_size
col_020.description: Total number of cards in the set including variants/promos; slightly more distinct values than col_002 (base size), same range. Joins to other tables are likely spurious.

col_021.name: type
col_021.description: Set type/category: promo, expansion, memorabilia, box, duel_deck, draft_innovation, archenemy, spellbook, premium_deck, core, etc.
